select eb.id, fd. businessCode, lb.outstock_id outStockId, lb.transport_no transportNo, eb.status, lb.shop_id shopId, lb.shop_name shopName, lb.to_country toCountry, lc.fee_rule feeRule, lbd.track_status transportStatus, lbd.sign_time signTime, eb.confirm_time confirmTime, eb.create_time createTime, lb.channel_id logisticsChannelId, eb.logistics_bill_id, lbc.reconciliation_status, lbc.currency from first_mile_estimated_bill eb inner join logistics_bill lb on eb.logistics_bill_id = lb.id and eb.is_deleted = false left join logistics_channel lc on lb.channel_id = lc.id left join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lb.id = lbd.main_id and lbd.is_deleted = false left join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lbc.is_deleted = FALSE AND eb.logistics_bill_id = lbc.logistics_bill_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fd.ID, concat ( fdd.fba_shipment_code, owi.code ) AS businessCode FROM wms_first_mile_delivery fd LEFT JOIN wms_first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fdd.main_id = fd.ID AND fdd.is_deleted =FALSE LEFT JOIN wms_overseas_warehouse_inbound owi ON owi.source_id = fd.ID AND owi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE ) AS fd ON lb.outstock_id = fd.ID
${params.sqlMap.default} and eb.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
eb.create_time DESC

select eb.id, lb.source_code businessCode, lb.outstock_id outStockId, lb.transport_no transportNo, eb.status, lb.shop_id shopId, lb.shop_name shopName, lb.to_country toCountry, lc.fee_rule feeRule, lbc.id logisticsBillCostId, lbc.currency, lbc.reconciliation_status actualBillStatus, lbd.track_status transportStatus, lbd.sign_time signTime, eb.confirm_time confirmTime, eb.create_time createTime, lb.channel_id logisticsChannelId, eb.logistics_bill_id from first_mile_estimated_bill eb inner join logistics_bill lb on eb.logistics_bill_id = lb.id and eb.is_deleted = false left join logistics_channel lc on lb.channel_id = lc.id left join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lb.id = lbd.main_id and lbd.is_deleted = false left join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lbc.logistics_bill_id = lb.id and lbc.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and eb.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
eb.create_time DESC

select lb.source_code businessCode, lb.outstock_code sourceCode, lb.transport_no transportNo, eb.status estimatedStatus, lbc.reconciliation_status actualStatus, lbc.track_no trackNo, lbc.id costId, lb.id logisticsBillId from logistics_bill lb inner join first_mile_estimated_bill eb on lb.id = eb.logistics_bill_id and eb.is_deleted = false inner join logistics_bill_cost lbc on lb.id = lbc.logistics_bill_id and lbc.is_deleted = false where lb.is_deleted = false
